name: job-market-analytics-platform
description: Intelligent Job Search, Recommendation and Recruitment Analytics Platform

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && npm run setup:env && npm run db:up && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
